## Trust checklist

- [ ] No fixture/mock result is presented as a real agent evaluation.
- [ ] Capture, proposal, evaluation, and promotion remain separate.
- [ ] User-authored agent configuration is not silently overwritten.
- [ ] New persistent behavior has an explicit rollback path.
- [ ] Vendor-specific protocol logic stays behind an adapter.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run release:check` passes.
